channel.title: Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: Sudan displaced face food, medicine shortages
item.description: Around 27,400 people in Blue Nile region lack basic supplies amid disease and calls for aid.

item.title: Sudan leader risks repeating Bashir's Russia gambit, analyst warns
item.description: Journalist Rasha Awad says Abdel Fattah al-Burhan's overtures to Moscow echo failed policies of the past.

item.title: South Sudan election order reversed
item.description: Elections are now scheduled for December 22 under the transitional constitution, reversing the agreed order for a permanent constitution first.

item.title: Russia raises South Sudan scholarship places to 40
item.description: President Vladimir Putin announced the increase for the 2026-2027 academic year during talks with President Salva Kiir in Moscow.

item.title: RSF drones hit 12 power stations across Sudan
item.description: Rapid Support Forces attacks since Monday have damaged transformers and fuel installations, causing widespread blackouts.
